results.title: Annual Assessment
results.description: Independent assessment results for the FedRAMP certification package.

observations.title: Assessment of MAS-CSO-IIR
observations.description: The independent assessor sampled the automated inventory against a manual resource enumeration during the FY26 annual assessment and found no discrepancies.

observations.title: Assessment of MAS-CSO-FLO
observations.description: Assessor confirmed via network configuration review that documented flows match observed traffic patterns during the FY26 annual assessment.

observations.title: Assessment of MAS-CSO-TPR
observations.description: Assessor verified the underlying IaaS platform's FedRAMP Certification status directly against the FedRAMP Marketplace during the FY26 annual assessment.

observations.title: Assessment of VDR-CSO-DET
observations.description: Assessor reviewed 90 days of scan coverage reports during the FY26 annual assessment and confirmed continuous full-boundary coverage with no unscanned assets identified.

observations.title: Assessment of CCM-OCR-AVL
observations.description: Assessor confirmed a consistent 2-week publication cadence by reviewing the trust center's report history for the trailing 6 months.

observations.title: Assessment of SCN-CSO-INF
observations.description: Assessor reviewed the most recent Significant Change Notification during the FY26 annual assessment and confirmed it contained all required elements.

observations.title: Assessment of KSI-IAM-APM
observations.description: Assessor queried the identity provider's authenticator report directly during the FY26 annual assessment and independently confirmed 97% passwordless/phishing-resistant coverage across active accounts.

observations.title: Assessment of KSI-IAM-JIT
observations.description: Assessor sampled 30 days of PAM activation logs during the FY26 annual assessment and confirmed all elevated sessions were time-bound and justified.

observations.title: Assessment of KSI-IAM-AAM
observations.description:
Assessor reviewed 90 days of IAM workflow lifecycle coverage reports during the FY26 annual assessment, confirming 100% of account lifecycle events were processed through the automated workflow with zero manual exceptions recorded.

Assessor independently sampled 25 privilege-modification workflow records and confirmed that a manager-approval record with a timestamp predating the privilege change existed in the workflow audit trail for each sampled event.

Assessor verified the Q2 2026 SIEM-to-identity-provider reconciliation report, confirming a 0% discrepancy across 2,341 IAM events, satisfying the non-repudiation requirement.

relevant-evidence.description: IAM workflow lifecycle coverage report, August 2026 — 847 lifecycle events, 100% automated, 0 manual exceptions
SIEM-to-identity-provider event reconciliation report, Q3 2026 — 0% discrepancy across 2,341 events

observations.title: Assessment of KSI-SVC-SIN
observations.description: Assessor reviewed configuration scan results and independently spot-checked 3 storage resources during the FY26 annual assessment, confirming encryption was enabled and using validated cryptographic modules.

relevant-evidence.description: Storage encryption configuration scan output, July 2026

observations.title: Assessment of KSI-MLA-OSM
observations.description: Assessor confirmed SIEM ingestion coverage across a sample of infrastructure components and reviewed retention configuration during the FY26 annual assessment.

observations.title: Assessment of KSI-CNA-RNT
observations.description: Assessor reviewed security group configurations and the nightly drift-detection alert history during the FY26 annual assessment and found no unresolved drift incidents.

relevant-evidence.description: Security group configuration export and drift-detection log, July 2026

observations.title: Assessment of KSI-INR-RIR
observations.description: Assessor reviewed the Q2 2026 tabletop simulation report and confirmed the incident reporting timeline met FedRAMP requirements.

relevant-evidence.description: Q2 2026 incident response tabletop exercise after-action summary
